title: vulnwatch collector report v1
description: Body of POST /api/collector/v1/report (Authorization: Bearer <device token>). At most 5 MB and one report every 5 minutes per device. The answer is always {"ok": true}: the server never sends commands or updates back.

id.description: Like ID in /etc/os-release, e.g. openwrt, unraid, dsm, alpine, debian. deb, rpm and apk packages are matched against this distribution.

ecosystem.description: Checked for CVEs: deb (Debian, Ubuntu), rpm (RHEL family, SUSE, Fedora …), apk (Alpine, Wolfi), npm, pypi, golang, cargo, gem, nuget and composer. Other ecosystems (opkg, slackware, synology …) are recorded; the coverage matrix shows the CVE check as n/a for them.

purl.description: Optional package URL; used as is when its type is one of the checked ecosystems (or maven).

repo_digests.description: As in docker inspect; needed for the check for newer images.

sbom.description: CycloneDX JSON of the image (syft <image> -o cyclonedx-json). Without it the image scan is n/a.
